status_summary: Executive Order 14149 (signed 2025-01-20, 90 FR 8243) directed the Attorney General, consulting agency heads, to review federal activities of the prior four years that conflicted with its free-speech policy and to report to the President. An Attorney General memorandum of 2025-02-05 created a Weaponization Working Group to review civil and criminal enforcement activity of departments and agencies over the last four years, listing named matters including a 2023 FBI memorandum, with quarterly reports to the White House, and rescinded the 2021 school-board memorandum. The memorandum names no active FBI investigation and does not direct a review of all major active FBI investigations; an undated Working Group report on the 2021 memorandum said most related FBI assessments had been closed or discontinued.

timeline.event: Executive Order 14149 directed the Attorney General, with agency heads, to review federal government activities of the prior four years that conflicted with its free-speech policy and to report findings and recommended remedies to the President.

The Attorney General issued a memorandum establishing a Weaponization Working Group to review enforcement activity across agencies over the prior four years, with named matters, and to send quarterly progress reports to the White House; a footnote rescinded the 2021 school-board threats memorandum.
